description: 6 exemplars (one German) + 4 near-misses + 1 counterexample. Exemplars cover keeping one character visually identical across AI video scenes (character lock, identity tokens). Near-misses are neighbours sharing its vocabulary: single-image generation (image-generation), prompt-only authoring (prompt-engineering-image), checking a found clip for defects (analyze:post) and storyboard planning (video:storyboard). The counterexample is logo work, which shares only the word design.

queries.q: keep the same character across all six scenes of my AI music video
create a character lock for Mia so her red jacket and silver ring stay identical in every clip
the hero's face drifts between scenes, how do I lock her identity tokens?
define silhouette, palette and wardrobe tokens so the mascot looks the same in every shot
same character in scene 1 and scene 4, please, the hair colour keeps changing
die Figur soll in allen Szenen gleich aussehen, Jacke und Ring dürfen sich nicht ändern
generate one portrait image of a woman in a red jacket
queries.note: single image, no cross-scene identity → image-generation

queries.q: write me a Midjourney prompt for a cyberpunk street scene
is this TikTok clip AI-generated? the ring on her hand disappears
design a logo mark for our bakery
plan the shot list and storyboard for a 30-second ad
